submission.justification: S3 has the highest stat-only significance (4.1σ at 50% efficiency, 2025 summary), but its data/MC disagreement in the signal-free validation region is 35%. The tolerance agreed with the conveners is 10%, and the cause is badly modelled jet-substructure inputs, so S3's background estimate is not robust and S3 is ruled out. S2 (kinematic-only NN) passes the validation check at 6% and gives 3.4σ, better than S1's 2.6σ (S1 passes at 3%). So S2 has the highest significance among the strategies that meet the constraints. I chose 50% efficiency because it is the only working point with documented sensitivity, and it lies inside the 20–80% window. No working-point scan tool was available, so I could not optimise the efficiency further. The significances are statistical-only and come from the 2025 summary. They should be redone with systematics and the 140 fb^-1 luminosity before the selection freeze.

requirements.evidence: S2 gives 3.4σ (stat-only, 50% eff.), the best of the strategies that pass validation. S3's 4.1σ doesn't count because S3 fails validation. Working point was not optimised; no scan tool was available.

requirements.requirement: Selection is one of the three strategies in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: Validation-region data/MC disagreement is 6%, within the agreed 10% tolerance (query_validation_region).
